name: Rouh's updates
title: Rouh's updates: this Rouh's own code brought to the newest release of Rouh, by itself (Ride along), on a press, or never, with its own changes kept

permissions: reads rouh.land's public release of Rouh's code (/mac/code/release.json): every half hour while it rides along, or on a press; a Rouh on its own asks only on a press
reads released changes from shared rouh-it/rouh-core main in order, copies untouched files exactly, and adapts diverged code through a frontier model and protected checks
adds the libraries a release needs to /extra, with the protected core's own installer, held to the base's pins
keeps code backups; the protected core makes fresh full database backups and rehearses migrations on real-data copies, verifying counts and preservation before applying atomically
on the Creator Rouh only: writes down which commit runs, and once a day publishes the newest commit that ran a day with nothing put back as rouh.land's release, signed with this Rouh's daily key
answers update_rouh in a chat ("update yourself to the newest Rouh"), the same path as the button on Anatomy, Meta, Changes, where its card is drawn
uses the Models setting Adapting master updates only with a frontier model; records copied, adapted and waiting changes in the local update ledger
jobs: the ride along and the Creator Rouh's releases, every half hour (code_update.Watch), and the note in General after an update's restart
touches.remove: Delete rouh/code_update.py, rouh/code_evolution.py, rouh/code_release.py, the updates part of rouh/web/changes.py and its three routes in rouh/project/urls.py, drawUpdates and its helpers in changespage.js and the cu- rules in changespage.css, code_updates in rouh/runtime.py, the update_rouh tool in rouh/tools.py and its names in toolsearch.py, protected.py and job_policy.py, the code-updates entry in rouh/genes/owners.json, and this manifest. The code a Rouh already took stays as it is.
